text:
Porter Martone is 20 games into his first full NHL season, and the sixth overall pick from 2025 is doing the part of the job rookies usually struggle with: he's making the Flyers better. Philadelphia's five-on-five expected-goals share is 7.3 points higher with him on the ice than without him, a strong sign for a rookie.

The points are only starting to come. He has eight in 20 games, four on the power play, and The Athletic's Kevin Kurz noted he had points in four of five games heading into the Rangers game. The Flyers have scored about three fewer goals than their chances deserved with him out there, so there's some help coming.

He plays big, 6'3" with 33 hits, and PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor summed up the other side of it in one post: "Porter Martone is such a good agitator." The Flyers have also started trying him with Trevor Zegras and Matvei Michkov after penalty kills. Our range has him around 18 goals and 43 points, right about where a top-six pick usually lands in year one.
headline: Porter Martone is learning on the job
